title: Council Order 0015442: fire-protection rating and installation evidence for exit stairwell door and frame assemblies in a ten-storey building
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order (respondent)
code_edition: Alberta Building Code 2006 (cited: Division B 3.1.8.4 and 3.1.8.5; NFPA 80; CAN4-S104-M)
document_date: 2014-10-24 (Council Order 0015442); the underlying order is dated 2014-08-21

facts.text: The appeal concerns a ten-storey building incorporating seven levels of underground parking.

The issues were: whether the exit stairwell door and frame assemblies show compliance with the test standard required by ABC 2006 Div B 3.1.8.4(1)(a); whether the tested assembly is representative of those installed; and whether installation complies with 3.1.8.5(2) and NFPA 80.

The varied order directs immediate stop-work on exit stairwell door installation (item 1); it requires full-scale test results or a published listing for the required fire-protection rating (items 2-3), NFPA 80 installation (the item before item 7) and removal and reinstallation of non-complying assemblies (item 7).
The panel's reasons record a large gap between the door frames and the surrounding wall opening, filled with foam and sealant, which the decision says the installation standard does not permit.
